purpose: Bounded pre-execution verification that trimming committed panels to as-of 2026-09-30 (ledger vintage) reproduces the frozen DISPERSION-003 grid ledger for representative cells, satisfying the F1GRID-002 preregistration's single-cell pre-check (H004V002 formation 2026-09-29 spread_gross 0.0, matching ledger) and demonstrating arm-A fidelity is feasible on the trimmed vintage. Full 216-cell arm A/B execution is deferred to the next session to stay within bounded runtime and to keep this session's artifact verifiable.

trim.scope: binance kline date, binance funding date, marketcap date trimmed <= 2026-09-30 for both arms
trim.label: ledger-vintage (as-of 2026-09-30) EXPLORATORY_ONLY development evidence; not comparable to current-vintage checkpoints; not confirmation

representative_fidelity_checks.method: Loaded committed panels, trimmed date <= 2026-09-30, built price wide/momentum cache/eligibility maps via unmodified run_dispersion003_grid functions, evaluated cells and compared n_formations, date_last and full formations arrays to committed grid_result_ledger.json cells.
representative_fidelity_checks.note: Representative coverage spans lookbacks/horizons/universe arms including both primary anchors (H004V105 legacy, H004V106 expanding) and a high-index cell (H004V216). This is a precheck, not a substitute for the full 216-cell fidelity gate required before any arm B comparison is written.

next_test: Execute scripts/run_f1_grid_vintage_trim.py to run the full 216-cell arm A fidelity check on the 2026-09-30-trimmed panels and, only if arm A reproduces the committed ledger within 1e-9 on every cell, evaluate arm B on the same vintage and write the descriptive comparison under this experiment root. Keep all outputs EXPLORATORY_ONLY; do not promote or modify frozen artifacts.
